تستكثرين (form X)
# تَسْتَكْثِرِينَ (tastakṯirīna) /tas.tak.θi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# تُسْتَكْثَرِينَ (tustakṯarīna) /tus.tak.θa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
